turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Hi there, come on in. What's your age?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm thirty-five. Thanks for seeing me on short notice.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Of course. Are you married, single, separated?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm single. I'm raising my son by myself.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: How many children live with you, and how old is your child?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Just one. My son is seven years old, sorry, it's actually eight.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Does he have any health or developmental needs we should know about?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: He has autism. He's had it since he was born, he was diagnosed as a baby, back in 2018.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thanks for sharing that. What's your total income for the year?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Around thirty-one thousand a year, from my job at the pharmacy.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Are you receiving the Canada Child Benefit?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, I get it for my son every month.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Last one: when did you file your taxes last?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I filed last spring, so that was for 2025.
